item.title: Some language introspection around Croatian loud and quiet
item.description: You know how by studying people with certain forms of brain damage, scientists can learn a lot about the brain and how it works? I wonder if it is equally promising to study people with a broken understanding of a language in order to learn about languages. I sat down today and started to introspect a small set of related words in Croatian that always bothered me. I am in a sense a native speaker of Croatian — I grew up in a household speaking Croatian, my mother and father spoke almost exclusively Croatian with me growing up.

item.title: Cohesion and disinformation
item.description: I guess that by now there is little doubt that the Russian and other governments, such as Iran, are having massively successful (dis)information campaigns on social media, in the countries of Europe and the US, and likely many others too. Their effectiveness is due to exploiting real existing disagreements in society, magnifying them, and blowing them up way beyond proportion. This ensures that society becomes further split, in fact so far that, amidst a booming economy and record low crime and unemployment rates, the fear of actual civil war and violent unrest is as high as it has not been for a century.

item.title: Thoughts on The Last Jedi
item.description: Reading this only makes sense if you have already watched The Last Jedi, and probably the other seven Episodes as well. Given how many surprises and twists have been in Episode VIII, I expect to be completely off, and to be delightfully surprised and entertained when Episode IX appears. For now, here’s my incomplete understanding of watching Episode VIII once and not understanding all of the dialogue. I really should start using subtitles in cinemas.
